title: Jay's Studies — Replay Curriculum Index v0.1

study_tracks.name: Verification Basics
study_tracks.goal: Turn broad narratives into narrow testable propositions.
study_tracks.completion: Learner can explain both what a record supports and what it does not support.

study_tracks.name: Source and Provenance
study_tracks.goal: Bind records to publisher, URL, date, version, bytes, and hash where available.
study_tracks.completion: Learner can distinguish independent sources from mirrors or quotations.

study_tracks.name: Person Office Authority
study_tracks.goal: Prevent identity, title, office, delegation, and authority from collapsing together.
study_tracks.completion: Learner replays office state at the relevant date instead of inheriting stale state.

study_tracks.name: Money and State Math
study_tracks.goal: Preserve the state of a number through budgets, obligations, outlays, recoveries, and audits.
study_tracks.completion: Learner can state what a number represents before comparing it.

study_tracks.name: ForwardReplay and ReverseReplay
study_tracks.goal: Trace provenance forward from origin and backward from newest record.
study_tracks.completion: Learner can reconstruct a record chain in both directions without adding unstated claims.

study_tracks.name: PlayBook Pincer
study_tracks.goal: Test one edge from LAW_TO_RECORD and RECORD_TO_LAW directions.
study_tracks.completion: Learner routes mismatch to HOLD or CONFLICT rather than forcing agreement.

study_tracks.name: Clerk
study_tracks.goal: Classify typed evidence edges without caller-supplied verdicts.
study_tracks.completion: Learner can distinguish evidence-gate disposition from legal or world-truth conclusions.

study_tracks.name: Conflict Replay
study_tracks.goal: Detect, classify, preserve, and replay valid disagreement between bound records.
study_tracks.completion: Learner can finish with CONFLICT when no bound superseding receipt resolves the edge.

study_tracks.name: Justice Dice
study_tracks.goal: Use precommitted randomness to select an audit lane without selecting truth, guilt, or authority.
study_tracks.completion: Learner understands that the roll chooses attention only.

study_tracks.name: Public Role Case Studies
study_tracks.goal: Use public officials and institutions as bounded case-study surfaces without biography drift or accusation mechanics.
study_tracks.completion: Learner can study a politically salient record while scoring only verification behavior.

study_tracks.name: Court OIG Congress Replay
study_tracks.completion: Learner can name the exact procedural state without semantic widening.

study_tracks.name: Receipt Engineering
study_tracks.goal: Represent study outputs as replayable receipts and immutable or versioned artifacts.
study_tracks.completion: Learner can reproduce the study state from its bound artifacts.
